demos.name: Privilege API Explorer LAB
demos.description: Connect to PingOne's hosted MCP server (worker or interactive admin sign-in) or any MCP server, list its tools with a safety class, and call them read-only by default. Mock by default; Live is owner-run.
demos.notes: Host-run: npm ci && npm run build && npm start (port 5201; npm run doctor checks it). Or: HOST_PORT=5201 docker compose up --build -d (published on 127.0.0.1 only). Mock mode needs no setup; Live is refused until the owner sets PRIVILEGE_EXPLORER_MODE=live. Not tested against a real tenant. The composeFile is relative to the folder the demo repos sit in.
